items.question_text:
Modify the checker to detect and reject any program that defines two
modules with the same name.
items.chinese_html: 修改检查器，使它能检测并拒绝在同一个程序中定义两个同名模块的情况。

items.question_text:
The procedure add-module-defn-to-env is not quite right,
because it adds all the values defined by the module, not just the ones in the inter-
face. Modify add-module-defn-to-env so that it adds to the environment only
the values declared in the interface. Does add-module-defn-to-tenv suffer from
the same problem?
items.chinese_html: 过程 add-module-defn-to-env 还不完全正确：它把模块体定义的全部值都加入了环境，而不只是接口中声明的那些值。修改该过程，使加入环境的模块只含接口声明的值。add-module-defn-to-tenv 是否也有同样的问题？

items.question_text:
Change the syntax of the language so that a qualified variable refer-
ence appears as m.v, rather than from m take v.
items.chinese_html: 修改语言语法，让限定变量引用写成 m.v，而不再写成 from m take v。

items.question_text:
Change the expression language to include multiple let declara-
tions, multiargument procedures, and multiple letrec declarations, as in exer-
cise 7.24.
items.chinese_html: 按照习题 7.24 扩展表达式语言，使其支持同一个 let 中的多个声明、多参数过程，以及同一个 letrec 中的多个声明。

items.question_text:
Allow let and letrec declarations to be used in module bodies.
      For example, one should be able to write

              module even-odd
               interface
                [even : int -> bool
                 odd : int -> bool]
               body
                letrec
                 bool local-odd (x : int) = ... (local-even -(x,1)) ...
                 bool local-even (x : int) = ... (local-odd -(x,1)) ...
                in [even = local-even
                    odd = local-odd]
items.chinese_html:
允许在模块体中使用 let 与 letrec 声明。例如，应当能够写出：

module even-odd
 interface
  [even : int -> bool
   odd : int -> bool]
 body
  letrec
   bool local-odd (x : int) = ... (local-even -(x,1)) ...
   bool local-even (x : int) = ... (local-odd -(x,1)) ...
  in [even = local-even
      odd = local-odd]

items.question_text:
Allow local module definitions to appear in module bodies. For
      example, one should be able to write

              module m1
               interface
                [u : int
                 v : int]
               body
                module m2
                 interface [v : int]
                 body [v = 33]
                [u = 44
                 v = -(from m2 take v, 1)]
items.chinese_html:
允许在模块体中出现局部模块定义。例如，应当能够写出：

module m1
 interface
  [u : int
   v : int]
 body
  module m2
   interface [v : int]
   body [v = 33]
  [u = 44
   v = -(from m2 take v, 1)]

items.question_text:
Extend your solution to the preceding exercise to allow modules to
      export other modules as components. For example, one should be able to write

              module m1
               interface
                [u : int
                 n : [v : int]]
               body
                module m2
                 interface [v : int]
                 body [v = 33]
                [u = 44
                 n = m2]

              from m1 take n take v
items.chinese_html:
扩展上一题的解答，允许模块把其他模块作为组成部分导出。例如，应当能够写出：

module m1
 interface
  [u : int
   n : [v : int]]
 body
  module m2
   interface [v : int]
   body [v = 33]
  [u = 44
   n = m2]

from m1 take n take v

items.question_text:
In our language, the module must produce the values in the same
      order as the interface, but that could easily be fixed. Fix it.
items.chinese_html: 在当前语言中，模块体必须按照接口中的顺序产生各个值，但这个限制很容易去掉。请修改实现，去掉这一顺序限制。

items.question_text:
We said that our module system should document the dependen-
      cies between modules. Add this capability to SIMPLE-MODULES by requiring a


depends-on clause in each module body and in the program body. Rather than
having all preceding modules in scope in a module m, a preceding module is in scope
only if it is listed in m’s depends-on clause. For example, consider the program

        module m1 ...
        module m2 ...
        module m3 ...
        module m4 ...
        module m5
         interface [...]
         body
          depends-on m1, m3
          [...]

In the body of m5, qualified variables would be in scope only if they came from m1 or
m3. A reference to from m4 take x would be ill-typed, even if m4 exported a value
for x.
items.chinese_html:
我们曾说模块系统应当记录模块之间的依赖关系。请给 SIMPLE-MODULES 增加这种能力：要求每个模块体和程序体都有一个 depends-on 子句。模块 m 中不再能看见此前的所有模块，只有在它的 depends-on 子句中列出的先前模块才在作用域内。例如，考虑程序：

module m1 ...
module m2 ...
module m3 ...
module m4 ...
module m5
 interface [...]
 body
  depends-on m1, m3
  [...]

在 m5 的模块体中，只有来自 m1 或 m3 的限定变量在作用域内。即使 m4 导出了值 x，引用 from m4 take x 也应判为类型不正确。

items.question_text:
We could also use a feature like depends-on to control when
module bodies are evaluated. Add this capability to SIMPLE-MODULES by requir-
ing an imports clause to each module body and program body. imports is like
depends-on, but has the additional property that the body of a module is evaluated
only when it is imported by some other module (using an imports clause).
Thus if our language had print expressions, the program

        module m1
         interface [] body [x = print(1)]
        module m2
         interface [] body [x = print(2)]
        module m3
         interface []
         body
          import m2
          [x = print(3)]
        import m3, m1
        33

would print 2, 3, and 1 before returning 33. Here the modules have empty interfaces,
because we are only concerned with the order in which the bodies are evaluated.
items.chinese_html:
也可以用类似 depends-on 的机制控制模块体何时求值。请给 SIMPLE-MODULES 增加这种能力：要求每个模块体和程序体有一个 imports 子句。它与 depends-on 类似，但还要求：只有当某个其他模块通过 imports 子句导入该模块时，模块体才求值。

因此，假如语言中有 print 表达式，下面的程序应先打印 2、3、1，再返回 33。这里各模块都使用空接口，因为我们只关心模块体的求值顺序。

module m1
 interface [] body [x = print(1)]
module m2
 interface [] body [x = print(2)]
module m3
 interface []
 body
  import m2
  [x = print(3)]
import m3, m1
33

items.question_text:
Modify the checker to use INFERRED as the language of expres-
sions. For this exercise you will need to modify <:-decls to use something other
than equal? to compare types. For example, in

        module m
         interface [f : (int -> int)]
         body [f = proc (x : ?) x]


            the actual type for f reported by the type inference engine will be something like
            (tvar07 -> tvar07), and this should be accepted. On the other hand, we should
            reject the module

                   module m
                    interface [f : (int -> bool)]
                    body [f = proc (x : ?) x]

            even though the type inference engine will report the same type (tvar07 ->
            tvar07) for f.
items.chinese_html:
修改检查器，使用 INFERRED 作为表达式语言。本题需要修改 <:-decls，比较类型时不能再直接使用 equal?。例如，下面模块中的 f，类型推导引擎可能报告为 (tvar07 -> tvar07)，但这个模块应当被接受：

module m
 interface [f : (int -> int)]
 body [f = proc (x : ?) x]

另一方面，即使推导引擎同样报告 (tvar07 -> tvar07)，下面的模块也应被拒绝：

module m
 interface [f : (int -> bool)]
 body [f = proc (x : ?) x]

In example 8.13, could the definition of and and not be moved from

items.question_text:
Write a module that implements arithmetic using a representation
      in which the integer k is represented as 5 ∗ k + 3.
items.chinese_html: 编写一个实现算术的模块，采用如下表示：整数 k 表示为 5×k+3。

items.question_text:
Consider the following alternate definition of mybool (exam-
ple 8.13):

        module mybool
         interface
          [opaque t
           true : t
           false : t
           and : (t -> (t -> t))
           not : (t -> t)
           to-bool : (t -> bool)]
         body
          [type t = int
           true = 1
           false = 0
           and = proc (x : t)
                  proc (y : t)
                    if zero?(x) then false else y
           not = proc (x : t)
                  if zero?(x) then true else false
           to-bool = proc (x : t)
                       if zero?(x) then zero?(1) else zero?(0)]
Is there any program of type int that returns one value using the original definition
of mybool, but a different value using the new definition?
items.chinese_html:
考虑下面对 mybool 的另一种定义（见例 8.13）：

module mybool
 interface
  [opaque t
   true : t
   false : t
   and : (t -> (t -> t))
   not : (t -> t)
   to-bool : (t -> bool)]
 body
  [type t = int
   true = 1
   false = 0
   and = proc (x : t)
          proc (y : t)
            if zero?(x) then false else y
   not = proc (x : t)
          if zero?(x) then true else false
   to-bool = proc (x : t)
               if zero?(x) then zero?(1) else zero?(0)]

是否存在一个类型为 int 的程序，使它在采用原来的 mybool 定义时返回一个值，而采用这个新定义时返回另一个值？

items.question_text:
Write a module that implements a simple abstraction of tables.
Your tables should be like environments, except that instead of binding symbols to
Scheme values, they bind integers to integers. The interface provides a value that rep-
resents an empty table and two procedures add-to-table and lookup-in-table
that are analogous to extend-env and apply-env. Since our language has only
one-argument procedures, we get the equivalent of multiargument procedures by
using Currying (exercise 3.20). You may model the empty table with a table that
returns 0 for any query. Here is an example using this module.

        module tables
         interface
          [opaque table
           empty : table
           add-to-table : (int -> (int -> (table -> table)))
           lookup-in-table : (int -> (table -> int))]
         body
          [type table = (int -> int)
           ...]

        let empty = from tables take empty
        in let add-binding = from tables take add-to-table
        in let lookup = from tables take lookup-in-table


                     in let table1 = (((add-binding 3) 300)
                                      (((add-binding 4) 400)
                                       (((add-binding 3) 600)
                                         empty)))
                     in -(((lookup 4) table1),
                          ((lookup 3) table1))

              This program should have type int. The table table1 binds 4 to 400 and 3 to 300,
              so the value of the program should be 100.
items.chinese_html:
编写一个实现简单表抽象的模块。表应当类似于环境，不过它把整数关联到整数，而不是把符号关联到 Scheme 值。接口提供表示空表的值，以及两个过程 add-to-table 和 lookup-in-table，分别类似于 extend-env 和 apply-env。由于本语言只有单参数过程，要用 Currying（见习题 3.20）获得相当于多参数过程的能力。可以用一个对任何查询都返回 0 的表表示空表。下面给出使用该模块的例子：

module tables
 interface
  [opaque table
   empty : table
   add-to-table : (int -> (int -> (table -> table)))
   lookup-in-table : (int -> (table -> int))]
 body
  [type table = (int -> int)
   ...]

let empty = from tables take empty
in let add-binding = from tables take add-to-table
in let lookup = from tables take lookup-in-table
in let table1 = (((add-binding 3) 300)
                 (((add-binding 4) 400)
                  (((add-binding 3) 600)
                    empty)))
in -(((lookup 4) table1),
     ((lookup 3) table1))

该程序应当具有类型 int。表 table1 把 4 关联到 400，把 3 关联到 300，因此程序值应为 100。

items.question_text:
Extend the system of this section to use the language of exercise 7.24,
      and then rewrite exercise 8.15 to use multiple arguments instead of procedure-
      returning procedures.
items.chinese_html: 扩展本节系统，使它使用习题 7.24 中的语言；然后重写习题 8.15，以多参数过程代替返回过程的过程。

items.question_text:
As you did in exercise 8.8, remove the restriction that a module
      must produce the values in the same order as the interface. Remember, however, that
      the definition must respect scoping rules, especially for types.
items.chinese_html: 像习题 8.8 一样，去掉模块体必须按照接口顺序产生值的限制。但要记住，定义仍须遵守作用域规则，尤其是类型的作用域规则。

items.question_text:
Our code depends on the invariant that every type in a type envi-
      ronment is already expanded. We enforce this invariant by calling expand-type in
      many places in the code. On the other hand, it would be easy to break the system
      by forgetting to call expand-type. Refactor the code so that there are fewer calls to
      expand-type, and the invariant is maintained more robustly.
items.chinese_html: 当前代码依赖一个不变量：类型环境中的每个类型都已经展开。我们在代码的许多位置调用 expand-type 来维护它，但只要漏掉一个调用，就容易破坏整个系统。请重构代码，减少 expand-type 的调用位置，并更可靠地维护这个不变量。

items.question_text:
The code for creating two1 and two2 in example 8.16 is repetitive
      and therefore ready for abstraction. Complete the definition of a module

             module from-int-maker
              interface
               ((ints : [opaque t
                         zero : t
                         succ : (t -> t)
                         pred : (t -> t)
                         is-zero : (t -> bool)])
                 => [from-int : (int -> from ints take t)])
              body
               ...

      that converts an integer expressed value to its representation in the module ints.
      Use your module to reproduce the computation of example 8.16. Use an argument
      bigger than two.
items.chinese_html:
例 8.16 中创建 two1 和 two2 的代码存在重复，因而适合抽象。补全下面模块的定义，把一个整数表达值转换成模块 ints 中该整数的表示。用你的模块重现例 8.16 的计算，实参应大于 2。

module from-int-maker
 interface
  ((ints : [opaque t
            zero : t
            succ : (t -> t)
            pred : (t -> t)
            is-zero : (t -> bool)])
   => [from-int : (int -> from ints take t)])
 body
  ...

items.question_text:
Complete the definition of the module

             module sum-prod-maker
              interface
               ((ints : [opaque t
                         zero : t
                         succ : (t -> t)
                         pred : (t -> t)
                         is-zero : (t -> bool)])
                => [plus : (from ints take t
                            -> (from ints take t
                                -> from ints take t))
                    times : (from ints take t
                             -> (from ints take t
                                  -> from ints take t))])
              body
               [plus = ...
                times = ...]


to define a module procedure that takes an implementation of arithmetic and pro-
duces sum and product procedures for that implementation. Use the definition of
plus from page 33, and something similar for times.
items.chinese_html:
补全下面模块的定义，构造一个模块过程：它接收一个算术实现，为该实现产生求和与求积过程。plus 使用印刷 p.33 的定义，times 使用类似方法。

module sum-prod-maker
 interface
  ((ints : [opaque t
            zero : t
            succ : (t -> t)
            pred : (t -> t)
            is-zero : (t -> bool)])
   => [plus : (from ints take t
               -> (from ints take t
                   -> from ints take t))
       times : (from ints take t
                -> (from ints take t
                    -> from ints take t))])
 body
  [plus = ...
   times = ...]

items.question_text:
Write a module table-of that is similar to the tables module of
exercise 8.15, except that it is parameterized over its contents, so one could write

        module mybool-tables
         interface
          [opaque table
           empty : table
           add-to-table : (int ->
                           (from mybool take t ->
                            (table -> table)))
           lookup-in-table : (int ->
                              (table ->
                               from mybool take t))]
         body
          (table-of mybool)

to define a table containing values of type from mybool take t.
items.chinese_html:
编写一个模块 table-of，类似于习题 8.15 的 tables 模块，但以表中内容的类型为参数。例如，应当能够写出下面的模块，定义一个保存 from mybool take t 类型值的表：

module mybool-tables
 interface
  [opaque table
   empty : table
   add-to-table : (int ->
                   (from mybool take t ->
                    (table -> table)))
   lookup-in-table : (int ->
                      (table ->
                       from mybool take t))]
 body
  (table-of mybool)

items.question_text:
Application of modules is currently allowed only for identifiers.
What goes wrong with the type rule for application if we try to check an application
like (m1 (m2 m3))?
items.chinese_html: 目前，模块应用只允许用于标识符。如果尝试检查 (m1 (m2 m3)) 这样的应用，现有的应用类型规则会出什么问题？

items.question_text:
Extend PROC-MODULES so that a module can take multiple argu-
ments, analogously to exercise 3.21.
items.chinese_html: 扩展 PROC-MODULES，仿照习题 3.21，让一个模块过程可以接收多个实参。

items.question_text:
Extend the language of module bodies to replace the production
      for module application by

                   ModuleBody ::= (ModuleBody ModuleBody)
                                  app-module-body (rator rand)
items.chinese_html:
扩展模块体语言，用下面的产生式替换模块应用原有的产生式：

ModuleBody ::= (ModuleBody ModuleBody)
               app-module-body (rator rand)

items.question_text:
In PROC-MODULES, we wind up having to write interfaces like

             [opaque t
              zero : t
              succ : (t -> t)
              pred : (t -> t)
              is-zero : (t -> bool)]

      over and over again. Add to the grammar for programs a facility for named inter-
      faces, so we could write

             interface int-interface = [opaque t
                                        zero : t
                                        succ : (t -> t)
                                        pred : (t -> t)
                                        is-zero : (t -> bool)]
             module make-to-int
              interface
               ((ints : int-interface)
                => [to-int : from ints take t -> int])
              body
               ...
items.chinese_html:
在 PROC-MODULES 中，我们不得不反复书写如下接口：

[opaque t
          zero : t
          succ : (t -> t)
          pred : (t -> t)
          is-zero : (t -> bool)]

请在程序的文法中增加命名接口机制，使我们能够写出：

interface int-interface = [opaque t
                           zero : t
                           succ : (t -> t)
                           pred : (t -> t)
                           is-zero : (t -> bool)]
module make-to-int
 interface
  ((ints : int-interface)
   => [to-int : from ints take t -> int])
 body
  ...
